title: apios carnea
intro: Apios carnea, commonly known as the potato bean or wild potato, is a perennial legume native to eastern North America. It is valued for its edible tubers and has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving digestion. The therapeutic actions of Apios carnea include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its use in treating various ailments. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
